Definition: Oreb, the name of a Midianite and of the cliff near the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Oreb was a prince of Midian, defeated in Gideon's victory. The men of Ephraim took him and slew him at the rock of Oreb, and brought his head to Gideon, and Isaiah remembers the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Oreb's fall shows what God does to the proud: the prince of Midian was slain at the rock that still bears his name, and the Lord remembered it against them.
